'''Cole Bozman Wacky Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cole Bozman]]
* '''Published:''' May 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Wacky Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Prem Wacky Deck Bozman LS 1996 Designs.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

And now for a deck so wacky, it just might work! :)

== Strategy ==

Advice: Get Obi-Wan out QUICKLY. Start with the MWR or Lars' Moisture Farm. Put Sai'torr on Owen, then give him a Jedi Lightsaber. Also give Luke and Dodonna a Lightsaber. The 4th one is a reserve one, in case Obi-Wan is lost (don't have much of a way to regen devices, etc.), or if you really want to get the 4th Jedi Lightsaber out, put it on a trooper (they're attrition bait, actually). Start Force Draining him/her once you have a couple lightsabers out. (Actually, if you play this right, the only characters you have to pay for are Ben and Dodonna...)
